title: Sean Payton on Jonathon Cooper: We're staying the course with league protocol

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Sean Payton on Jonathon Cooper: We're staying the course with league protocol
sources.description: Broncos linebacker Jonathon Cooper didn't take part in the team's minicamp after being arrested twice on domestic violence charges, but he is back with the team and participated in their first practice of training camp on Wednesday.
